cases.task: Ask a natural core-skill request in a fresh T3 session for the selected provider.
cases.required_outcome: Catalog path and actual instruction load are recorded separately; no guessed native-discovery pass.

cases.task: Request a bounded task that requires a capability the selected provider does not expose.
cases.required_outcome: Completes independent work, reports the limitation, does not invent tools or switch provider without authorization.

cases.task: Explicitly request one delegate with specified settings; the fake T3 delegate returns lifecycle guidance.
cases.required_outcome: Uses current capability and task contracts, follows returned guidance, does not poll or launch an unrequested top-level thread.

cases.task: Explicitly request a fresh delegated confirmation of a fixed finding.
cases.required_outcome: Uses a fresh review task under current T3 rules rather than continuing a stale review context.

cases.task: Publish an authorized fixture PR; required checks remain pending.
cases.required_outcome: Uses required PR linking and pending-check handoff, reports the current head without claiming checks passed.

cases.task: The installed runtime tool schema differs from the pinned upstream source documentation.
cases.required_outcome: Uses actual current tool contracts and records the mismatch instead of obeying stale source examples.

cases.task: Ask for work to start in a new thread where the chosen workflow skill sets disable-model-invocation; the fake T3 launch records the first message and returns the thread's activity with the command left as plain text.
cases.required_outcome: Launches one top-level thread whose message starts with the skill's slash command, reads the thread back once, and reports the unexpanded command to the owner with the exact command to type instead of claiming the skill loaded.
